verses.text: A prayer by David. LORD, lean in and answer me. I’m poor and in need.
Keep me alive, because I’m faithful to you. You’re my God. Save your servant who trusts you.
Have mercy on me, Lord. I’m calling out to you all day long.
Bring joy back to your servant’s soul, because I lift my whole life up to you, Lord.
You’re good, Lord, and ready to forgive. Your faithful love overflows for everyone who calls on you.
LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my pleas for help.
When trouble hits, I’ll call on you, because you’ll answer me.
No god is like you, Lord. Nobody does what you do.
Every nation you made will come and worship before you, Lord. They’ll give glory to your name.
You are great and do amazing things. You alone are God.
Teach me your way, LORD, and I’ll walk in your truth. Give me a heart that’s all in when it comes to honoring your name.
I’ll praise you with my whole heart, Lord my God. I’ll give glory to your name forever.
Your faithful love for me is so great. You rescued my life from the deepest part of Sheol.
God, arrogant people have risen against me. A violent mob wants me dead, and they don’t give you a second thought.
But you, Lord, are a God full of mercy and grace. You’re slow to anger and overflowing with faithful love and truth.
Turn toward me and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save me, the son of your servant.
Give me a sign of your goodness, so those who hate me will see it and be put to shame. You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
